judge_issues.message: Working capital months claim of 37.9 needs to be checked against the specific source year context.

The charity is classified under 'fi_sabilillah', but its core programs focus on disability inclusion, masjid accessibility certification, and special needs education. While noble, these services generally align better with community services or disability support rather than strict traditional definitions of Fi Sabilillah unless restricted to eligible poor/needy students or participants.

strengths_deep_dive: Muhsen fills a critical niche within North American Muslim communities by advocating for individuals with special needs. The charity's program infrastructure includes <cite id="3">15 active weekend schools</cite> and specialized volunteer networks, supported by <cite id="4">502 trained volunteers</cite> [4]. Financial management shows notable efficiency in development costs, as <cite id="15">fundraising expenses consume just $0.07 per $1 raised</cite> [15]. Additionally, governance standards remain strong, backed by an independent board structure and a <cite id="15">Charity Navigator score of 86.5/100</cite> [15].
rich_narrative.summary: Muhsen aims to establish inclusive Muslim communities for individuals with disabilities [3]. The organization operates programs including masjid certification, weekend schools, respite care, and wellness support groups across the United States and Canada [3]. In FY2024, Muhsen generated <cite id="15">$3,305,007 in revenue</cite>, reflecting steady organizational expansion [1]. The non-profit maintains a strong commitment to transparency, earning a <cite id="15">Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid</cite>. However, financial efficiency presents a mixed picture. In FY2024, Muhsen recorded a <cite id="15">program expense ratio of 57.4%</cite>, which falls below the 75% industry standard [15]. Simultaneously, the organization maintains significant financial reserves, holding nearly 37.9 months of working capital [15]. For zakat donors, this combination of moderate program spending and extensive reserve accumulation represents an important operational consideration [2].
